purpose: Freeze schema-inspection semantics before any PRRP data-file payload is opened.

FishPassage-System-wide.rule: inspect every listed non-PDF non-log data file; do not choose among multiple files by content

Geomorphology.rule: inspect every listed non-PDF non-log data file; do not choose among multiple files by content

WaterQuality.rule: inspect every listed non-PDF non-log data file; do not choose among multiple files by content

accdb_or_mdb: download the exact frozen file after Gate0 PASS
verify size/hash when metadata are available
extract table schema/column names and types only
csv_or_tsv: do not read the first data row
xlsx_or_xls: read header row only from each sheet
do not read the first data row
documentation: record filenames and sizes only in Gate1
do not use report results to choose variables or worlds

forbidden_operations: read any post-removal focal response value
choose a table because it contains favorable focal response
drop a module because its schema is inconvenient
alter focal species, B proxy, time periods or world rules
schema_gate_outputs: whether a deterministic reach/site/year linkage is possible without reading focal response values
whether predeclared A/B/M variable classes can be instantiated
next_stage_if_pass: freeze exact column bindings, reach linkage, A standardization/centrality formula, B parser/cutoffs, M graph representation and output schema before reading any focal response row
